rules.rule1: Place your ships on the board before battle begins.
rules.rule2: Take turns firing at the enemy grid.
rules.rule3: Red X marks a hit, gray dot marks a miss.
rules.rule4: Sink all enemy ships to win!
rules.objectiveDesc: Sink all 5 enemy ships to win the game.
rules.setupDesc: Place your 5 ships on the 10x10 grid. Ships can be placed horizontally or vertically.
rules.gameplayDesc: Take turns firing at enemy coordinates. Hit all parts of a ship to sink it.
rules.endDesc: The player who sinks all 5 enemy ships first wins the game.
